# dsh-plugins

Personal DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugins for the **web** profile.
Each plugin is a standard `dsh` b
undle: a `cordis.patch.yml` host row plus a browser half declared through `dsh.client`.
| Plugin | Description |
| `agent-monitor` | Floating monitor card: running sessions and their active subagents (name, task b

rief, model, reasoning effort, status). Auto-refresh every 2s. |
| `quick-notes` | Quick-notes float
ing panel: timestamped entries, clock, alarms with flashing reminder, API prices & balances, day/wee
k/month/year grouping. |
